text: 乘联分会秘书长崔东树发文称，2026年8月车市零售环比回升5.5%，是油价高位压制、宏观景气偏弱、政策预期升温、成都车展带动等多重因素交织共振的结果。地缘冲突持续困扰霍尔木兹海峡的通航，推动国际油价维持高位震荡，2026年国内汽油价格累计上调已超1720元/吨，尤其7月底以来上涨了180元，大幅抬高了燃油车用车成本，国内燃油乘用车消费需求持续剧烈萎缩。8月制造业PMI环比回升0.6%至49.8%，仍处于荣枯线之下，终端内需边际虽回暖但力度有限。8月上中旬高温假抑制终端到店客流、下旬成都车展带动市场热度回升、月末冲量拉动日均零售修复，终端订单与客流呈现前低
text_en: Cui Dongshu, Secretary-General of the China Passenger Car Association, wrote in an article that in August 2026, car market retail rebounded 5.5% month-on-month, the result of a combination of multiple factors including high oil prices weighing on the market, weak macroeconomic sentiment, rising policy expectations, and the boost from the Chengdu auto show. Ongoing geopolitical conflicts continue to trouble navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, pushing international oil prices to remain volatile at high levels. In 2026, domestic gasoline prices have cumulatively risen by more than 1,720 yuan per ton, including an increase of 180 yuan since the end of July, greatly raising the cost of using fuel vehicles, and domestic fuel passenger vehicle consumer demand has continued to shrink sharply. In August, the manufacturing PMI rebounded 0.6 percentage points month-on-month to 49.8%, still below the boom-or-bust line. Although marginal terminal domestic demand warmed somewhat, the momentum was limited.
